_about: Public-domain Job Orton (1717-1783), Dissenting minister at Shrewsbury, Doddridge's pupil, for the Word Hoard: his Practical Works (London: Tegg, 1842, two volumes) and A Short and Plain Exposition of the Old Testament (Shrewsbury 1788-1791, six volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 46 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
